results.title: Faɗan ɓangarorin ƴan ta'adda 2 a Burkina Faso ya kashe mutane fiye da 400- Rahoto
results.content: Wani rahoto da ƙungiyar ACLED mai sanya idanu a yankunan da ake fama da rikice-rikice ta fitar , bayyana yadda aka samu wani rikici tsakanin ɓangarorin ƴan ta’adda biyu dukkaninsu masu iƙirarin jihadi akan iyakar Burkina Faso da Mali, rikicin da ya kashe adadi mai yawa na ɓatagarin, wanda ƙungiyar ke cewa shi ne mafi muni da aka taɓa gani tsakanin ƴanta’addan na yankin Sahel.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Jensen na kamfanin Nvidia ya yi murabus,bayan saɓawa dokokin aiki
results.content: Babban Kamfanin fasahar ƙirƙirarriyar basirar AI, Nvidia, ya sanar da cewa shugabansa, Jensen Huang ya yi murabus a jiya Alhamis, bayan da aka bankaɗo mu’ammalar soyayya da yayi da wasu mata biyu, ciki har da wata mace da ake zargi da yi wa China aikin leƙen asiri.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Kamfanin Microsoft na Amurka, na fuskantar matsalolin intanet
results.content: Kamfanin Microsoft na Amurka,ya sanar da fuskantar matsaloli a bangaren da ya shafi aikewa da sakonni na imel a bangaren Outlook a duk duniya,kamfanin ya yi watsi da wasu bayanai da ke nuna cewa da alama an yi kokarin kai masa hari ta hanyar intanet.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: DSS ta kama ƙunshin makamai da aka yi fasa ƙwaurinsu daga Jamhuriyar Nijar
results.content: Jam’iyar Hukumar tsaro ta farin kaya ta DSS a Najeriya, sun samu nasarar kama ƙunshin wasu makamai da aka yi fasa ƙwaurinsu daga makwabciyar ƙasar Jamhuriyar Nijar. Wata majiyar tsaro ce dai ya sanar da wannan nasara, inda ta ce DSS sun kama makaman ne a lokacin da suke gudanar da aiki a garin Dawakawa da ke ƙaramar hukumar Goronyo ta jihar Sokoto.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Ƴan ta’adda na amfani da mata wajen safarar makamai a Najeriya
results.content: Sakamakon yadda jami’an tsaron Najeriya suka matsa ƙaimi wajen kama masu safarar makamai zuwa cikin ƙasar, rahotanni na nuna cewar a yanzu ƴan ta’addan na amfani da mata wajen safarar makamai a sassa daban daban na ƙasar.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Kotu a Libya ta yanke wa wani tsohon kwamanda da mukaranbansa hukuncin kisa
results.content: Ofishin mai gabatar da kara na Tripoli a Libya a ranar laraba ce ta yanke wa wani tsohon kwamandan wata kungiya mai ɗauke da makamai da mataimakansa shida hukuncin kisa saboda hannunsu a kisan kai biyu da sace-sacen mutane da dama a shekarar 2016. Wannan shi ne karo na farko da aka samu ƴan bindiga shida da shugabansu da laifin kashe mata biyu da kuma tsare ƴa'yansu na tsawon watanni shida.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Sojojin Salvador 2,000 da aka tura ƙungiyoyin 'yan daba a Haiti
results.content: A Haiti, kimanin sojojin Salvador 2,000 da aka tura a Port-au-Prince na ci gaba da samun galaba a kokarinsu na wargaza ƴan daba masu ɗauke da makamai da ke cin karensu ba babbaka.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: An yi arangama tsakanin jami'an tsaro da masu haƙar ma'adinai a Guinea
results.content: Rahotanni daga ƙasar Guinea na cewa mutane da dama sun rasa rayukan su sakamakon arangama tsakanin jami’an tsaro da masu haƙar zinare ba bisa ƙa’ida ba a garin Boure-Balatoda da ke yankin Siguri, a arewa maso gabashin ƙasar.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An kama mutane biyu a India da ake zargi da kashe mutum bayan ya hadiye alewa
results.content: Ƴansandan India sun kama mutane biyu da ake zargi da kashe mutum na uku ta hanyar yaudararsa ya hadiye wani abin fashewa da suka kira a matsayin alewa da ake amfani da shi wajen kashe alade.

results.title: Jami'ar Nsukka (UNN), a Enugu, ta tabbatar da mutuwar dalibanta
results.content: Jami'ar Nsukka (UNN), a Enugu a Najeriya, ta tabbatar da mutuwar dalibanta hudu bayan wani biki da aka gudanar a wani gidan haya a yankin Hill Top na Nsukka. Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar, Simon Ortuanya, ya tabbatar da faruwar lamarin yayin da yake zantawa da manema labarai a harabar jami'ar a jiya Alhamis.

results.title: Mutum shida sun mutu a sabbin hare-haren da Isra'ila ta kai gabashin Gaza
results.content: Wani harin da dakarun Isra’ila suka kai kudancin Gaza ya kashe akalla mutum shida.

results.title: Masana sun ce fassara bayanan zaɓen Najeriya zuwa harsunan gida zai kawo zaman lafiya
results.content: Masana a fannin ƙa'idojin watsa labarai da manazarta harkokin siyasa, sun ce akwai buƙatar sanya adalci da yin la'akari da al'adu wajen aikin fassarar bayanan zaɓe zuwa harsunan gida cikin aminci, ba wai sauya kalmomi daga wani yare zuwa wani kawai ba, kasancewar akwai harsunan asali sama da 500 a Najeriya.

results.title: Ghana ta samar da sabbin takardun kuɗin da za a fara amfani da su a watan gobe
results.content: Ghana ta sauya takartun kuɗinta ta hanyar samar da ƙanana masu nagarta, waɗanda ta inganta tsare-tsaren da za su basu kariya daga samar da jabunsu, a dai-dai lokacin da take sabunta kuɗaɗen ta.

results.title: Ƴan bangar siyasa sun kai hari kan magoya bayan jam'iyar NDC a Lagos
results.content: Wasu da ake zargin ƴan bangar siyasa ne sun kai hari a wajen taron magoya bayan jam’iyar NDC a yankin Oregun na jihar Lagos.

results.title: Palace ta kori kocinta watanni 5 bayan fara aiki
results.content: Shugabannin Crystal Palace sun kori kocin ‘yan wasansu Pierre Sage, watanni biyar bayan karɓar ragamar jagorancin ƙungiyar, wadda a halin yanzu ka matsayi na ƙarshe a gasar Firimiya

results.title: Carrick ya zama koci na 17 da United ta sallama cikin shekaru 13
results.content: Michael Carrick ya zama kocin Manchester United na 3 da ƙungiyar ta kora a daidai lokacin da kakar wasa ta kankama.

results.title: Guterres ya roƙi ƙasashe su daina amfani da makamashi masu guba don ceto duniya
results.content: Sakatare Janar na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, Antonio Guterres, ya yi kira ga shugabannin ƙasashe da su kawo ƙarshen dogaro da man fetur, iskar gas, da kwal a taron sauyin yanayi na COP31 da ke gudana a birnin Antalya na Turkiyya.
